claim_text: Frozen 320 logical schedules: 8 binding-specific families x 32 adversarial schedules = 256 adversarial plus 64 valid controls (GLHS-A05); scientific unit is the logical schedule.
Every adversarial schedule holds current state/governance coordinates valid and changes only the disclosure dependency (C-007, GLHS-A03); controls preserve all fields (GLHS-A04).

The no-binding arm is evaluation-only: never selectable through production HTTP/env/tenant/runtime flags (GLHS-A02); services/** cannot import the package (GR-03, C-004); no disable_binding/no_exact_binding flag exists in services/**.
Gate C arm-diff: for every schedule the two arm executions are byte-identical on all non-binding governance coordinates; only the exact disclosure dependency check differs.

Primary analysis frozen pre-execution: paired invalid-commit acceptance on 256 adversarial schedules, numerator/denominator, paired risk difference + 95% paired bootstrap CI (deterministic seed), discordant counts, exact McNemar, per-family; no adaptive sample size (GLHS-A06).
Exact-binding arm rejects all 256 invalid-commit adversarial schedules and accepts all 64 valid controls through the production admission path over isolated PostgreSQL.

No-binding arm admits all 256 adversarial schedules while preserving all governance coordinates; paired RD is 1.0 (95% paired bootstrap CI 1.0 to 1.0) and exact two-sided McNemar p=1.727233711018889e-77.
Raw executions are append-only and hash-chained; observer re-verifies the chain and fails closed on tamper.
Seal covers exactly what executed: SHA-256 of protocol, schedules, sources, raw streams and analysis; backend is isolated PostgreSQL and is reported honestly.
No SQLite smoke result is retained or used as final evidence; the retained result is the isolated PostgreSQL run.
